note.text: Commercial dental PPO coverage (contrast UC02a's Texas Medicaid). Benefit detail confirmed at the 2026-07-08 real-time benefit verification (a named UC02b test objective): annual maximum $2,000/plan year with $1,720 remaining at time of verification; basic services (D7210 extraction) covered 80% after deductible; major services (D6010 implant) covered 50% after deductible; implant waiting period waived (plan year 3+). NO prior authorization required for D7210 or D6010 — confirmed via CRD (negative result), so no DTR/PAS in this use case. The remaining-annual-maximum and waiting-period values are member- and point-in-time-specific and in the real world are returned by the PDex/271 benefit response rather than stored on the Coverage resource; they are captured here in narrative form. The fixed plan-level benefit percentages and annual maximum live on InsurancePlan/insplan-commercial-dental-ppo.
